title: ESPN's NFL Draft documentary reveals Cowboys made first-round trade offer to Browns

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: ESPN's NFL Draft documentary reveals Cowboys made first-round trade offer to Browns
sources.description: The Browns mulled it over before declining the offer, which included the Cowboys asking for the Nos. 9 and 24 overall picks in exchange for picks Nos. 12 and 20, and a fifth-rounder.
